Ana (partnerships): Quick alert: several HW partner customers reported charges during last night's marketplace flip. Entitlements created but activation webhook delayed ~10-20m for a subset. :thinking_face:

Lina (partner-success): Partners are NovaGrid + OrbitalSI. Two customers opened tickets; one enterprise trial.

Marcus (billing): If raw usage hit ledger before entitlement active we must not invoice. Can integrations mark those events asap?

Zoe (integrations): Running a focused query now for events where usage_ts < activation_ts inside the cutover window. I'll tag matches with "billing_hold=true" and add entitlement_verified=false. Sample SQL: ```sql
SELECT id, acct, usage_ts, activation_ts FROM marketplace_usage WHERE usage_ts < activation_ts AND activation_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-22T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T02:00:00Z';
```

Tariq (sre): Root cause: activator autoscaler used an outdated metric name after deploy. I fixed metric config and scaled workers; backlog is draining. Will replay activations.

Marcus (billing): Good. Once Zoe tags events, freeze invoice generation for affected accounts and produce credit memos where billable_tokens > $0 and entitlement_verified remains false after 24h. We'll run a reconciliation: compare sum(tokens where entitlement_verified=true) vs ledger.

Lina (partner-success): I'll prepare partner and customer notes: apology, mitigation, credit process, ETA. Ana—can you include a short cutover playbook change to default ingestion to non-invoiceable for 5m after a cutover?

Ana (partnerships): Yup. Proposal: cutover-guard feature that sets invoiceable=false by default for 5m and auto-tags events. Tariq/Zoe to scope.

cutover-bot: NOTE: activator autoscale fix applied at 2026-03-22T02:11:15Z; replay_job.completed=true; queue_depth=0."
